summary.ru: Маркграфство Бранденбург — одно из наиболее значительных княжеств в Священной Римской империи, существовавшее с 1157 года вплоть до ликвидации Германо-римской империи в 1806 году.
summary.en: The Margraviate of Brandenburg was a major principality of the Holy Roman Empire from 1157 to 1806. Though initially an underdeveloped and economically modest territory, Brandenburg held electoral status within the Empire. Facing land division with Küstrin as recent as middle in the 16th century, it then quickly reunited and grew rapidly in importance after inheriting the Duchy of Prussia in 1618. Brandenburg came to play a pivotal role in both German and European history as the core of the Prussian kingdom.
